How Rainwater Harvesting Works

🌧️ 1. Rainfall

Rain falls on the rooftop.

🏠 2. Collection

Gutters and pipes direct rainwater to a collection point.

🛢️ 3. Storage

Collected water is stored or directed to a suitable groundwater recharge system.

Calculation Formula

Gross rainwater (litres) = Roof area (m²) × Rainfall (mm)

Collectable water = Gross rainwater × Efficiency ÷ 100

Example: 100 m² × 800 mm × 80% = 64,000 litres.
